items.text: the ring lingers when it closes: its dots fold home over about a second (the one you chose stays lit a moment first), then its middle fades over a second and a half; tap the middle while it fades to open the ring again, or its pin to open it pinned
flow on the Play ring reads 0 to 100%, like volume, instead of ×1.5, so the number no longer jumps in width
the Play ring has no mute: volume at zero is mute
tapping the chosen ring dot again to turn its second page (touchable sound) keeps the ring open; the dot bumps once instead of vanishing and coming back
a dot that plays with the sound has a thin edge that swells and brightens with every sound and every beat, so you can see it is listening
the magnet's push is a dark green instead of orange, so push and pull differ in lightness for colour-blind eyes
the magnet on the beat no longer pulses a pill behind PUSH / PULL, so its drawer keeps still; the ring round the icon shows the beat
the ring's round middle has no highlight inside it: the pin, grip and arrows round its edge rest a little dim and brighten under your finger, and sit nearer the rim so the middle breathes
a ring dot that sets an amount (volume, flow, the levels) wears it as an arc round its edge, like the dice's timer, so you can read it at a glance
drag a value dot up or down and keep going past it: the dot holds your finger and shows the number inside
tap a value dot and the ring's middle becomes its dial, the level round its edge and the number inside; drag up or down anywhere, tap it to give the middle back. No more bar across the ring
a ring dot with a second page shows it quietly: two small points inside the dot near its bottom, one filled for the page you are on, no frame
a double-tap with the Apple Pencil opens the ring, as a finger's does
drag a ring from anywhere on its middle, the name and the pin included, not only the grip; the panel arrow, the ring switch and a slider keep their own touch, and a tap is still a tap
the Touch ring is push, steer or magnet. The hand in the middle turns touch on and off (lit when on): off, the dots dim and keep your choice, and nothing that says off is ever lit

touchable sound is a second page on your choice: tap the lit dot again and two points on its edge show the page, and its edge pulses with the sound. With touch off it still plays: the picture stays still, your finger plays
touchable sound has its own mark, a fingertip on a wave, on the Touch ring and on the Sound ring (finger), one switch in both places
Touch panel › ring labels: learn (they fade once you know them), always or never
the rings are tighter: a smaller middle, the dots closer to it
the ring keeps in step with the bar: turn the robot on or mute from the bar, a key or a shelf and an open (or pinned) ring shows it at once, and still turns to move
a path's numbered dot under a bar button also sits on the ring dot that does the same thing
